questions.question: The employee handbook states the human resources manager is ------- for reviewing job applications.
questions.explanationText:
(1) KHUNG: Mệnh đề phụ có chủ ngữ "the human resources manager" và động từ to be "is", phía sau là giới từ "for". Chỗ trống cần điền một tính từ đóng vai trò bổ ngữ cho chủ ngữ.
(2) LUẬT: Đây là câu kiểm tra từ vựng tính từ. Cần chọn một tính từ phù hợp về nghĩa và kết hợp đúng với giới từ "for" theo sau.
(3) ĐÁP ÁN: (C) responsible vì tạo thành cụm "be responsible for" (chịu trách nhiệm về việc gì), dịch kèm chủ ngữ: "manager is responsible for" (người quản lý chịu trách nhiệm cho...).
(4) LOẠI:
(A) reasonable (adj): hợp lý — thường đi kèm price, excuse, rate. Không hợp nghĩa trong ngữ cảnh công việc.
(B) genuine (adj): chính hãng, chân thật — thường đi kèm leather, parts, interest. Không hợp nghĩa.
(D) applicable (adj): có thể áp dụng — thường đi kèm giới từ "to" (applicable to), không đi với "for".

explanation.title: Giải thích

LHM Production & Operations Management Conference

Call for Seminar Proposals

Lindqvist Heavy Machinery (LHM) will convene the inaugural LHM Production & Operations Management Conference on 12–13 August at the Valencia Convention Centre. We are calling for proposals from production and operations experts to lead seminars on their organizations' successful actions in response to operational challenges. The ideal seminar topic will relate to the conference theme of "Progress in the Age of Automation," but other topics will also be accepted.

Proposals must be between 150 and 250 words long and accompanied by an overview of the submitter's credentials. Roughly 25 proposals will be chosen for presentation in seminar form; if many more submissions are received, additional submitters may be invited to participate in themed 60-minute panel discussions instead. Submitters should be aware that proposals chosen for seminars must then be submitted to the Production & Operations Management Society (POMS) for approval so that each seminar will count as two hours of professional development for POMS members in attendance.

Please use this online form to send your proposal to the conference's organizing committee by 10 December.

ROTTERDAM (3 April)—Northgate Energy has finalized the sites for a large-scale renewable energy initiative in the region that would supply electricity to thousands of homes and businesses. The initiative will involve the installation of wind turbines at four locations. These sites have already been evaluated for environmental considerations and have obtained the necessary permits from the provincial and national governments. Northgate Energy will build the turbines and substations themselves, but construction of the transmission lines linking the electricity output to the distribution grid will be managed by a third party. Kenji Osei

The Quartzon QZ9 is a 1200-watt countertop microwave oven with a rotating turntable that can hold plates of up to 14 inches in diameter. Its AutoChef technology can warm up five common foods like popcorn and vegetables at pre-set power levels until its heat sensor determines that they are ready, while the defrost function makes it simple to thaw frozen meals.

http://www.quartzon.com/reviews ▼

Reviewer: Beatriz Bhatt

Date posted: February 4

My parents gave me their three-year-old QZ9 microwave when I moved into my first apartment a few months ago. I have been using it frequently, because I eat Apex QuickMeals—those plastic bowls of food you put directly into the microwave—several times a week.

Then, last week, the turntable stopped spinning. The microwave has a four-year warranty, so I contacted the nearest certified Quartzon repair center and scheduled an appointment. The technician stated the drive motor would need to be replaced and asked to view my warranty. He then checked the name on it and said the agreement is no longer valid because it cannot be transferred between owners. Rather than being free, my repair will cost around $150, which is frustrating. I am writing this review to caution others who might not be aware of this term of the warranty agreement.

E-Mail message
To:Beatriz Bhatt <b.bhatt@you-mail.com>
From:Lars Reyes <lreyes@quartzon.com>
Subject:Quartzon QZ9
Date:February 5

Dear Ms. Bhatt,

I am writing in response to the review you published on our Web site. As a member of the Quartzon customer service team, I would like to explain that the policy that warranties are non-transferable was implemented three years ago and does not apply to purchases made prior to then. I apologize for the trouble you have experienced with your microwave's operation and with the service delivered by our certified repair partner.

Customer satisfaction is of utmost importance to Quartzon Manufacturing, so I would like to offer my help with resolving this matter. Please let me know the name of the company that you corresponded with. I will reach out to its management and make sure that your repair is handled correctly.

Regards,

Lars Reyes

Customer Service Representative
